::: info SEED-IDEMPOTENT
**Seed rows are idempotent, and local**

Put a few example rows in a &lt;script type="application/sql"&gt; block in index.html so the application is not an empty shell on first open, written so a second open adds nothing (INSERT … WHERE NOT EXISTS, or INSERT OR IGNORE with a fixed id). Never seed from schema.sql. Seed only local tables this way; see SHARED-SEED-THROUGH-SURFACE for shared ones.

**Why.** The block runs on every open, so a seed that is not idempotent duplicates itself each time the document is opened.

<small>Applies to every shape · not checked by anything · [SEED-IDEMPOTENT in Constraints](/docs/constraints#SEED-IDEMPOTENT)</small>
:::
